title: The Galaxy Becomes a Cockpit
plan: Galactic cockpit pass: action rail, hue families, dated journey, CLI-up law
context: Captured from the installed navcom 0.11.0 bridge on the owner's real chart (147 harvested sources, 6,693 conversations). Every button is one API call that is the twin of a navcom command, and the same command is printed beside it.
proofTarget: the bridge can act on any place without bending the CLI: same services, same commands, same answers; dated travel survives reload; the headless CLI is untouched and faster.
beats: Every system keeps its own color; inside a system, its products share that family
Select a product: one action rail, each action paired with its exact navcom command
The rail's files panel and the copied CLI command return the same 98 retained files
Ask expert opens a review with its command; nothing is sent from a click
Syra as of Oct 1, 2026: land in sign-in, search login, read the pinned source, reload — still there

captions.04-rail-files-panel.png: Browse saved files → 1–40 of 98 retained files: _layout.tsx 625 B, forgot-password-confirm.tsx 13,037 B
captions.05-cli-twin-same-files.png: The copied command run in a terminal: the same files, the same sizes — the UI is a view over the CLI
captions.06-star-rail.png: A living star (Hermes expert): its rail offers inspect, history and Ask — no special-case UI
captions.07-ask-opens-review-not-send.png: Ask expert opens a REVIEW dialog with the exact navcom atlas ask command; nothing is sent from a click
captions.08-syra-as-of-oct-1.png: Explore time: Syra reconstructed at 2026-10-01 12:00 UTC from the saved, pinned session

captions.11-reload-keeps-dated-journey.png: Reload: still Oct 1, still sign in, still 'login', Back to dated system ready — the reload bug is fixed

verdict.headline: The cockpit acts, the CLI stays clean
lines: PROVEN: rail actions are twin calls of the printed navcom commands (UI files == CLI files)
PROVEN: dated journey UI == API across Back/Forward/reload/copied link (7/7 live), no cache writes
PROVEN: 1,156 pytest + 176 BDD scenarios green; architecture law enforced by 143 tests
PROVEN: headless CLI loads zero galaxy code; sigpipe 0.14 s, import 0.05 s
OPEN: live microphone (voice → future living star) and captain boarding (needs a local route or remote attachment)
